tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Studio page background: library, editor, settings.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs and inputs raised on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: segmented-control tracks, text areas, meters.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and toggles (3:1 on paper, surface and surface-sunk).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, helper text, inactive tabs, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta text: timestamps, word counts, captions; on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action on a screen (Record, Mark up, Save).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: cue
tokens.usage: The signature amber: brand mark, the stressed-word highlight, the Accept-all fill. A fill, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-cue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every Studio surface.

tokens.name: cue-stress
tokens.usage: Stressed words: text colour in the editor. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: cue-pause
tokens.usage: Pause and long-pause glyphs after a word, and the PAUSE hold badge. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: cue-breath
tokens.usage: Breath glyph after a word and the BREATHE hold badge. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: cue-slower
tokens.usage: Slow-down arrow, its gutter bar and the tint of a slower run. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: cue-faster
tokens.usage: Speed-up arrow, its gutter bar and the tint of a faster run. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: cue-energy
tokens.usage: Words in an energy lift and the bolt that opens the run. Studio only; the stage uses the matching stage- token.

tokens.name: tint-slower
tokens.usage: Background behind the words of a slower run.

tokens.name: tint-faster
tokens.usage: Background behind the words of a faster run.

tokens.name: tint-select
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the word a sheet is editing.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: The tally: REC dot, recording timer, stop button. Only while the camera or screen is live.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: Delete, failed save.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivery review: a cue that was delivered (always with a check icon).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Delivery review: a cue that was missed or rushed (always with an icon).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Prompter background. True black, which disappears on beam-splitter glass.

tokens.name: stage-scrim
tokens.usage: Prompter panel over a live camera preview.

tokens.name: stage-text
tokens.usage: Script text on stage and stage-scrim. Warm off-white to cut glare.

tokens.name: stage-text-read
tokens.usage: Words above the reading line, already spoken.

tokens.name: stage-line
tokens.usage: The reading line across the prompter.

tokens.name: stage-chrome
tokens.usage: Control bar and HUD fill on stage.

tokens.name: stage-chrome-text
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on stage-chrome and stage.

tokens.name: stage-stress
tokens.usage: Stressed words on the stage (13.7:1 on stage).

tokens.name: stage-pause
tokens.usage: Pause glyphs and the PAUSE badge on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-breath
tokens.usage: Breath glyph and the BREATHE badge on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-slower
tokens.usage: Slow-down label and gutter bar on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-faster
tokens.usage: Speed-up label and gutter bar on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-energy
tokens.usage: Energy words and bolt on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-tint-slower
tokens.usage: Behind the words of a slower run on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-tint-faster
tokens.usage: Behind the words of a faster run on the stage.

tokens.name: stage-rec
tokens.usage: The tally on the stage and in the HUD.

tokens.name: stage-ok
tokens.usage: Device checks on the stage that passed: the camera is on, the microphone is heard. Always with a check icon.

tokens.name: stage-warn
tokens.usage: Device checks on the stage that need the user: no sound, the microphone is blocked. Always with an icon and a way to fix it.

tokens.name: stage-glass
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces over live content: the HUD, the cursor companion, the prompter panel over a camera preview. Always with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: stage-glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px inner edge that lifts glass off what is behind it.

tokens.name: caption-text
tokens.usage: Captions burned into the video. Always with the caption shadow for legibility on any footage.

tokens.name: caption-plate
tokens.usage: Optional plate behind Karaoke captions on busy footage.

tokens.name: caption-waiting
tokens.usage: Karaoke words that have not started; fixed half-white on the caption plate.

tokens.name: ripple
tokens.usage: Click ripples and the cursor halo in edited screen recordings (the cue amber, fixed across themes).

families.reading: "Readex Pro", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Say it like you mean it
styles.usage: Empty states, the export screen and the wordmark, in Anybody at width 112. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen and script titles, in Anybody at width 100.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap a word to change its cue.
styles.usage: Default UI text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: List subtitles, helper text, card notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta text under controls.

styles.name: script-edit
styles.sample: Last quarter, our support team answered 12,000 tickets.
styles.usage: Script text in the editor's Marks view (Latin). Room between lines for cue glyphs.

styles.name: script-edit-ar
styles.usage: Script text in the editor for Arabic: taller lines for Arabic ascenders and marks.

styles.name: stage-s
styles.usage: Prompter over a phone camera preview, or a small desktop window.

styles.name: stage-m
styles.usage: Default prompter size.

styles.name: stage-l
styles.usage: Prompter read from 1.5 to 3 m, or on teleprompter glass.

styles.name: stage-xl
styles.usage: Beyond 3 m or on a large monitor.

styles.name: stage-m-ar
styles.usage: Default prompter size for Arabic; every stage size gets line height 1.6 in Arabic.

styles.name: caption-cue
styles.usage: Cue captions at a 1080px-high frame (scale with the frame): Anybody 700, two lines at most, lower third. Stressed words widen to 130 and pop.

styles.name: caption-punch
styles.usage: Punch captions for vertical video: Anybody 800, one to three words at a time, centred. Fast runs condense to width 75, slow runs stretch to 125.

styles.name: caption-karaoke
styles.usage: Karaoke captions for tutorials: Anybody 600, the whole line, filled word by word.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Recording timer, take durations, time left.

styles.name: meter
styles.usage: Words per minute, speed readouts.

styles.name: signal-label
styles.usage: Capitalised stage labels: hold badges, REC, Hidden from recording.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: let the key point sink in
styles.usage: The director's margin notes beside cues in the editor. Lower case, never more than six words.

styles.name: note-ar
styles.usage: Margin notes in Arabic scripts, in Aref Ruqaa.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Countdown numerals: arrive at width 150, settle to 100 within the beat.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-word gap, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and sheet inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on large screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; prompter side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Largest step: stage top padding above the first line.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tints behind words and selection highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, cue pills, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the recording HUD.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The record button, hold badges, the camera bubble.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: the recording HUD, the prompter window, sheets. Cards use borders, not shadows.

duration.note: Motion timing. Motion that carries delivery timing (the scroll, hold badges, countdown) is exempt from these and follows the delivery timeline.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback on buttons and keys.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Toggles, chips, accepting a cue, hold badges appearing.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab changes, the record-button morph.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Going on stage: Studio chrome fades out and the stage dims in.

tokens.name: dur-beat
tokens.usage: One countdown beat.

tokens.name: dur-hud-hit-poll
tokens.usage: Refresh click-through around the recording HUD's interactive controls.

tokens.name: dur-companion-poll
tokens.usage: Sample transient pointer position for the companion spring. Never stored.

tokens.name: dur-companion-rest
tokens.usage: Pointer stillness before the companion returns under the lens.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between cues when a markup pass draws in; cap the whole pass at 800ms.

tokens.name: dur-preview-poll
tokens.usage: Check live-preview size and source availability; this does not drive capture frames.

tokens.name: dur-review-context
tokens.usage: Original speech before and after a filler phrase audition; not an animation duration.

tokens.name: dur-recording-poll
tokens.usage: Read recording state and microphone level for the HUD and Voice pace; capture uses its own clock.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Things that move into place: sheets, badges, cues.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things that leave: closing sheets, the Studio chrome going on stage.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Press, toggle and morph.

tokens.name: ease-scroll
tokens.usage: The prompter scroll within a line. Speed changes between runs blend over 300ms.

tokens.name: reading-line
tokens.usage: Height of the reading line from the top of the prompter. Adjustable 20% to 45%.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Widest text column under a camera, so eye movement stays invisible on camera.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Leading gutter for pace bars and the reading caret (20px min, 64px max).

tokens.name: read-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity of the words above the reading line.

tokens.name: floating-width
tokens.usage: Initial logical width of the excluded desktop prompter.

tokens.name: floating-height
tokens.usage: Initial logical height of the excluded desktop prompter.

tokens.name: floating-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest excluded prompter width that keeps its controls readable.

tokens.name: floating-min-height
tokens.usage: Smallest excluded prompter height that leaves room for the reading line.

tokens.name: floating-min-opacity
tokens.usage: Lowest desktop prompter opacity. The capture exclusion applies at every opacity.

tokens.name: hud-width
tokens.usage: Excluded recording HUD width, with timer, microphone and controls.

tokens.name: hud-height
tokens.usage: Excluded recording HUD height.

tokens.name: hud-question-height
tokens.usage: Protected HUD height while choosing camera companion behaviour.

tokens.name: companion-width
tokens.usage: Logical width of the compact cursor reader.

tokens.name: companion-height
tokens.usage: Logical height of the compact cursor reader.

tokens.name: companion-gap
tokens.usage: Clear space between the cursor and the trailing reader.

tokens.name: companion-opacity
tokens.usage: Native glass-card opacity; regular reader retains its chosen opacity.

tokens.name: companion-jitter
tokens.usage: Pointer movement needed to change trailing side or reset stillness.

tokens.name: countdown-window-size
tokens.usage: Excluded countdown size before the HUD docks at the bottom.

tokens.name: mic-meter-height
tokens.usage: Live microphone meter in the recording HUD.

tokens.name: camera-bubble-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the excluded desktop camera self-view beside the reader.

spring.note: Physical motion as mass stiffness damping, as Flutter's SpringDescription takes them. Springs, not fixed durations, drive everything that moves in response to a person or to the take.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Presses, toggles, chips, cue glyphs arriving (damping ratio 0.79, about 250ms).

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards, shared-element moves between screens (critically damped, about 400ms, no overshoot).

tokens.name: spring-pop
tokens.usage: The one bouncy spring: stressed words popping in captions and on the prompter (damping ratio 0.46, one visible overshoot).

tokens.name: spring-camera
tokens.usage: Zooms and pans in edited screen recordings, and camera punch-ins (critically damped, about 650ms).

tokens.name: spring-follow
tokens.usage: The cursor companion trailing the pointer (critically damped, about 450ms of lag).

review.note: Themed Studio take review and video playback.

tokens.name: player-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum take preview width; controls remain outside the picture.

tokens.name: player-max-height
tokens.usage: Maximum portrait or landscape preview height in take review.

video-export.note: First full-picture Windows export; optional separate camera inset.

tokens.name: camera-margin
